notes.title: Next Level Mutation!
notes.content:
Dear friends of Music and Sound,

Over the last two years, in addition to developing Soniface, we have also improved and developed Mutant. There are small developments in many places that improve the overall experience of the app.

With this update, we are introducing the Mutant Cloud. It is a pool of your own sound scenes, beats and presets. The cloud opens up a journey of ever new mutations of your created scene.

We have also improved the display of instrument notes. This is complemented by a new interface in which you can set scales and chords. These are then applied to the instruments.

We invite you to check out our weekly livestreams at [url=https://www.youtube.com/@mazetools]https://www.youtube.com/@mazetools[/url] to get in touch with us, ask questions and enjoy our live sessions in the Ectoplastic Lab with us.

We hope you enjoy Mazetools Mutant!

Update
Improved app performance, interface & audio quality
New chord & scale interface
Snapshot Cloud: to load Snapshot into a 3D cloud (offline) defined by perception features mood, energy & structure
Interactive cloud navigation and Snapshot filtering by author, key & tempo
Snapshot Mutation Interface to merge two Snapshots
Improved Setup Interface
New Guide, improved in-app help in english & german

notes.content:

Mutant is a space to experiment: a complex yet highly intuitive visual interface that invites you to play with sound and create music in new ways. Moreover, it features a collaborative mode, that allows you to engage in live sessions with other users.

Check out our Website to get more information about Mazetools Mutant.
